description: Material-event filing header (high-cadence hot-path attestation). R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263800 §3 (CorpFilingEventSensor). Authored by W3 sensors (`sec_edgar_rss_sensor` + `jp_edinet_api_sensor`) reading published filing-event feeds. This lexicon yields HEADERS only — full filing body is referenced via `payloadCid` for the cold-path corpus. ossekai (ADR-2605263600) is the primary aggregate-publication consumer of high-cadence material-event observations.

eventKind.description: Per-jurisdiction event taxonomy. Examples: '8-K item 1.01' (US material agreement) / '8-K item 2.01' (US asset acquisition) / 大量保有変更 (JP large-holding amendment) / etc.

eventSummary.description: Short header excerpt only (NOT full filing body). Body lives at payloadCid.
